description:
The Fantastic Four's most powerful member and their greatest adversary are joining the fight against Annihilus! 

THIS IS GOING TO SHAKE THINGS UP!

In this second DLC, Invisible Woman and Doctor Doom head to MARVEL Cosmic Invasion, increasing the base game to 17 playable Super Heroes for an intergalactic adventure that will see them face off against the fearsome Annihilation Wave!

The Siege of Castle Doom is launching on November 10th and a brand-new game mode will arrive alongside our two new Super Heroes!
